description: Returns step-by-step guidance for a task, including the Warhammer 40,000 knowledge and tool order it needs. Read the matching skill before starting the task. Skills: answer-a-rules-question: Answer a Warhammer 40,000 rules question from Praetorium's reference, citing the source. Use when someone asks how a rule, ability, stratagem, keyword, datasheet value or mission works. build-a-roster: Plan a Warhammer 40,000 army list from Praetorium's current units, points and detachments, weigh what each detachment gives a unit, and save the list to the player's Praetorium account when they ask. Use when someone wants to build, draft, improve, cost or save an army or roster, choose a detachment, or asks how a unit fits a list. choose-secondaries: Help a Warhammer 40,000 player choose between Tactical and Fixed secondary missions for a mission and opponent, from the secondary cards in Praetorium's reference. Use when someone asks which secondaries to take, or whether to go fixed or tactical. compare-units: Compare two Warhammer 40,000 units with Praetorium's combat simulator and explain the expected result. Use when someone asks how one unit does against another, which of two options hits harder, which wargear is best against a target, or what the odds are of destroying a target. explain-a-mission-matchup: Explain which primary missions, deployments and terrain two Warhammer 40,000 force dispositions get in a mission pack, from Praetorium. Use when someone asks what mission they play against an opponent's disposition, or how to set up a game in the current pack. grade-a-roster: Grade a Warhammer 40,000 army list with Praetorium, explain what it does well and lacks, and tune it with tested swaps. Use when someone asks how good their list is, what it is missing, how to improve it, or before handing over a list you built. import-a-list: Bring an army list from the official Warhammer 40,000 app, New Recruit, BattleBase or another builder into Praetorium, report what didn't match, and check, grade, save or export it. Use when someone pastes a list or exchange code, or asks to import, check or convert a list from another app. plan-a-matchup: Plan how a player's Warhammer 40,000 list takes on one opponent with Praetorium's simulator and mission data. Use when someone asks how to play their list against an army, which of their units handle the opponent's threats, or who should play the objectives. play-in-a-tournament: Take a signed-in player through a tournament, hidden-list game or group league: join, seal a list, find their table, start the battle and report the score. Use when someone asks what's due, wants to seal a list, or asks who they play next. review-a-battle: Summarise one of a signed-in player's Praetorium battles from its report, such as how the score built up, which stratagems were used and the turning points. Use when someone asks how a game went or wants a write-up of it. review-my-battles: Look back at a player's Praetorium battles and record, such as results against an army, win rates by detachment or mission pack, and leaderboard places. Use when someone asks how they've been doing, who they lose to, or to find a past game. set-up-a-battle: Start a Praetorium battle for a signed-in player and set the table in the order the game does, from opponent and armies to the first turn. Use when someone wants to start, create or set up a game to track. track-a-battle: Read a Praetorium battle and record what happens during play for a signed-in player, such as phases, command points, stratagems, scoring, casualties and undo. Use when someone asks about the score or state of their battle, or wants to record something that happened in it.
name: get_skill
title: Read a Praetorium skill
